description: A ground-level photograph displaying a dense natural or semi-natural mixed forest. The image is dominated by numerous tall, slender tree trunks with light brown bark, ascending vertically towards an unseen canopy. The forest floor and lower to mid-levels are thickly covered with lush, vibrant green undergrowth, comprising various shrubs and leafy plants that form a rich understorey. Dappled light filtering through the canopy suggests a daytime setting. Faint text in the bottom-left corner of the image reads "COPYRIGHT EEA", indicating the European Environment Agency as the copyright holder. This photograph provides a visual example for the definition and classification of mixed forest land cover types in environmental documentation.
